name: inspect_experiments
description: Human overview of a selected bundle with shared status evidence, scripts and bounded stdout/stderr. Use inspect_run for structured exact inspection.

parameters.bundle: Required. The logical bundle name (e.g., the value passed to autoslurm-schedule).
parameters.date: Optional ISO-8601 or autoslurm DATE_FORMAT; nearest-date convenience selection, not exact identity.

name: list_experiments
description: Enumerate all bundle files for a given name so the agent can pick the desired timestamp.

parameters.bundle: Required. The bundle base name to scan (will match jobs/<bundle>_*.json).

name: schedule
description: Persist a fully formed job dict into the bundle directory (append or new bundle).

parameters.bundle: Required unless the job dict already contains a bundle entry.
parameters.job: Required. A dict containing at least 'script' and 'slurm'; optional 'name', 'dependencies', etc.
parameters.append: Optional boolean. When true, appends to the latest bundle instead of creating a new timestamped file.

name: gather_context
description: Return the agent folder context (documentation, examples, schema) as a single concatenated string.

parameters.sections: Optional list of filenames or substrings to filter the agent files that are included.
parameters.task: Optional keyword or action name that automatically selects relevant sections.

name: list_submissions
description: List local submission receipts without querying or submitting scheduler work.

name: inspect_submission
description: Read an exact local receipt; explicit refresh fetches only its execution-side receipt, never resubmitting.

parameters.receipt_path: Required exact local receipt path returned by submit_jobs or list_submissions.
parameters.refresh: Optional boolean, default false. True may contact the recorded producing machine.

name: list_runs
description: Discover exact local saved run paths without scheduler or network calls. Includes drafts and submissions; inspect one exact path next.

name: inspect_run
description: Observe an exact saved run through the shared Python/terminal pipeline. Scheduler failures and unknown tasks remain explicit; no scheduler mutations.

parameters.bundle_path: Select exactly one of bundle_path or receipt_path. Exact local saved snapshot path.
parameters.receipt_path: Exact local submission receipt path, used to select its tracking snapshot. Reads local evidence; use inspect_submission refresh to fetch a remote receipt first.
parameters.refresh: Optional boolean, default true. Query producing scheduler; false uses stale cached evidence and performs no network calls.
parameters.include_logs: Optional boolean, default false. Include bounded producing stdout/stderr; refresh controls remote fetching too.
parameters.job_name: Optional concrete job name to restrict logs.
parameters.task_index: Optional concrete declared/observed array index to restrict logs.
parameters.tail: Optional nonnegative integer, default 40 lines per log.
parameters.max_log_bytes: Optional bound per log read, 1..1048576, default 65536 bytes.
parameters.max_logs: Optional file bound 1..100, default 20; omitted files are reported.
parameters.stream: Optional both/stdout/stderr selector, applied before log-file bounds. Merged output belongs to both streams.
